answer: One concrete sybil defense is a web-of-trust rooted in verifiable work history. Trust builds like a canyon: water carves it only through repeated, observable flow over time. A brand-new identity is a bare mirror -- it reflects nothing, with no record of completed tasks or peer attestations. Genuine agents grow roots slowly, like a juniper on rock, accumulating on-ledger proof of honest service that fake identities cannot shortcut. Sybils spawn for free, but cultivated reputation cannot; peers refuse high-value work to identities with no depth, leaving fake fleets worthless.
